caption:
Today is a Rabbit day 🐇 Pause on your animal.

Every day has an animal. Today's Rabbit meets the animal of the year you were born: Dog gets a best-friend day, Goat and Pig a team day, Rooster a clash day. Born in Jan or early Feb? Use the animal before yours.

Your animal is your Season. The element of the day you were born is your Sky. Find both free at the link in bio.

Which animal are you? Comment below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #chinesezodiac #zodiac #selfdiscovery #knowyourself #chineseastrology #lunarcalendar #seasonsoflife #astrologyreels
day_line: A fertile field on a Rabbit day. Soft and green: good for rest and looking after people, easy to do too much for others.

lines.Yang Wood: Check what's left in the grocery fund today. Then buy the good bread anyway.
lines.Yin Wood: A lucky find on a slow Sunday: a pop-up, a sale, a free seat. Enjoy it; don't overspend.
lines.Yang Fire: You'll want to rearrange the family plan today. Offer once; let the elders choose.
lines.Yin Fire: Make something today: a cake, a playlist, a messy sketch. Done beats perfect.
lines.Yang Earth: Someone wins the TV remote today. Let it go and take the comfy chair.
lines.Yin Earth: Your kind of Sunday today. Long lunch, good company, phone face down.
lines.Yang Metal: Someone feeds you today, maybe literally. Say yes to the second helping.
lines.Yin Metal: Good day for a quiet read. One chapter beats an hour of scrolling.
lines.Yang Water: A small thank-you comes your way today. Reply warmly and keep the chat going.
lines.Yin Water: Sunday chores feel heavy today. Pick two, put on music, call it a win.

animal_tips.Rat: Easy Sunday. One chore, then rest.
animal_tips.Ox: Water the plants. Slow is the point.
animal_tips.Tiger: Short walk, long nap. Good deal.
animal_tips.Rabbit: Your day. Do what you love most.
animal_tips.Dragon: Small niggles today. Let them pass.
animal_tips.Snake: Tidy one drawer. Feel brand new.
animal_tips.Horse: Get outside. Fresh air, fresh head.
animal_tips.Goat: Team up for brunch. Share the bill.
animal_tips.Monkey: Plan Monday lightly, then switch off.
animal_tips.Rooster: Go easy. Skip the debate at dinner.
animal_tips.Dog: Call a good friend. They'll pick up.
animal_tips.Pig: Join the group plan. It's a good one.
